title: chore(north-star, pm-dispatch): blocked states follow the Blocked-by lines, the maintainer brief is four business lines, nine passages follow the merged area and grading rules

_Requested by **Warren, Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgXFRsfSS1tQB1kBxAZ86579)_

Fixes #35259
Fixes #35298
Fixes #35230
Fixes #35246

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；车队内部，一张卡被谁挡着只看卡上写明的那一行，挡路的卡都办完后每日巡检点名把它放回队列，等你拍板超过三天的问题每天列给你，你收到的 PR 和决定卡最上面改成四句业务话。
- 为什么做：属于「产品分区与定级规则落地」专题里的车队规则整理；你说先立卡改阻塞机制、速读要从业务角度写，另有九处旧说法和已合并的分区定级规则对不上。
- 出错会怎样：只动车队规则文字和每日巡检，不碰产品代码；巡检只报不改，最坏是车队多看到或少看到几行提醒，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：核对规则文字和你的原话一致后批准合并。

## What changes

Three cards of one folded family land as one PR (claim comments 7000835776, 7000844817, 7000854625). The rule text of the first card was taken over from the previous card thread's checkpoint `cbdd979f6a`, re-read against the card's items and kept.

The maintainer's words, verbatim, as the cards quote them (Warren, 2026-11-19 unless dated):

Ruling-ref: blocking mechanism (card body of #35259): 00:26Z 「先立卡改机制，排查现有的卡改状态」; 00:28Z 「这种问题也应该优化 skills： 等维护者做的那一步，单独立一张维护者卡；开发卡关掉，被挡的卡放开。」; 00:32Z 「可以拆的都同意。」; 00:32Z 「如果需要技能优化也要处理」.

Ruling-ref: issue-type rules (scope comment 6998230415): 02:52Z 「同意」.

Ruling-ref: a decision for the maintainer is reviewed at the ceiling tier before it reaches him (scope comment 6998694957), 03:21Z, quoted as written:

> 「还有 车道 应该定一条规则，所有需要我决策的，先用fable 评审，再和我讨论。」

Ruling-ref: its effort level (comment 6999656302): 04:24Z 「1+2+4」, which for that rule means effort `xhigh`, and `max` only when he names it.

Ruling-ref: four-line brief (card body of #35298): 02:54Z 「目前的维护者速读，写的其实不是很好，感觉很多废话，应该从业务的角度写。」; 02:55Z 「同意」 to the four-line shape.

Ruling-ref: contradictions clean-up (card body of #35230): 2026-11-18 16:19Z 「同意」 to the fleet skills review and its order of steps.

Ruling-ref: one PR for the three cards, and the hand-off (claim comments 7000277771 and 7000835776): Warren 04:54Z 「那你还是直接派发吧」, 04:55Z 「为什么不能合并派发」, 05:27Z 「都提交代码，交接给 seat 5」; Bill 05:32Z 「这些你都接手」.

### 1. Blocked states follow the `Blocked-by:` lines (#35259)

Rule text:

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈状态模型〉: the rows for `needs-user-decision`, `pm:on-hold`, `pm:blocked` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` now say that the line-start `Blocked-by:` line is the only source of a block, that a block whose targets have all closed is released by the daily scan, that holds match, that the maintainer's step gets its own card, and that a product choice goes to the decision box. The `pm:blocking` row is removed. Two lines under the label rules say the relation is read from the lines by script and a blocker takes the top grade; a grade set by hand is not moved. 〈升级与决策〉 says a decision for the maintainer goes through the ceiling-tier decision thread first.
- `references/state-machine.md` (+7 lines): card items 1 to 4, 7, 9 and 10.
- `references/filing-gate.md` (+4 lines): fleet cards of one topic block each other only when they edit the same file; block only the part that waits; no card for a problem in a feature whose code has not merged; the issue type is set card by card. The blocker-grade line is rewritten in place.
- `references/decision-analysis.md` (+1 line here): the analysis and the brief are written by the ceiling-tier decision thread at effort `xhigh`. The seat-tier fallback with its `Analysis-tier:` line is removed; no script read that line (`git grep Analysis-tier` on main hits that one line).
- `references/triage-duties.md`, `execution-duties.md` (-1 line), `coordinator.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`, `lanes/director.md`, `lanes/objectstack.md`: the passages that read the retired label or the seat-tier decision path, rewritten in place.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (+2 lines here): a dev run never asks the maintainer directly; a `blocked` report names which part of the card can go first.
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, only the two passages the scope comments name: Priority rule 2's type sentence (slowness, refactor and operations work, experience problems, type per card) and its "Someone is waiting" addendum (a blocker takes the highest grade among its own and the open cards it blocks; no label is typed for the relation).

Daily patrol, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (report-only, as before):

| Dispatch item | Row | What it reports |
|:--|:--|:--|
| (a) no `Blocked-by:` line | H4, unchanged | a `pm:blocked` card with no line |
| (a) line names no open target | H77, new | the line names no card or PR, or only PRs that closed unmerged |
| (b) every target closed, a PR merged | H19, row text extended | the candidate for release back to `pm:queue` |
| (c) blocker graded below a card it blocks | H78, new | on the blocker; says a fleet-written grade is raised by triage and a hand-set one is not moved |
| (d) hold mismatch | H79, new | both directions; the forward one states the default |
| (e) mutual blocks and cycles | H80, new | one row per group, on its lowest-numbered card |
| (f) product decision unanswered | H81, new | a decision-box card with no ruling, open more than 3 days |

- (b) is reported, not written: this script has no write path. The row is the candidate; the daily scan returns the card to `pm:queue` with one comment after the installable check, or rewrites the line to the next real blocker.
- H14 and H15, the two checks that audited the `pm:blocking` cache label, are removed.
- Every new row has firing cases beside the control that silences it (battery `H77-H81 blocking relation read from the lines`), and each guard was ablated once (Tests).

Label retired: `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` drops the `pm:blocking` row (the label object is left as it is; `--reconcile` can neither recreate nor re-describe it). Readers updated: the patrol's residue set, its read order for queued cards and its comment gate; the two `scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs` self-test cases that used the label as residue. After this PR `git grep pm:blocking` hits only the patrol's own retirement pins and the retirement note in the vocabulary script.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: ceiling rows and their comments only (table in Acceptance notes).

### 2. The maintainer brief is four business lines (#35298)

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (+3 lines): the PR brief is at most four lines, one Chinese business sentence each (用户能看到什么变化 / 为什么做 / 出错会怎样 / 要你做什么), with the ⛔ list (no code names, file paths, commands, ruling letters or bare card numbers). Files to read first and the two-minute verification move to the English part and are not deleted.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (in place): six lines become four; the approve-ask line is renamed 「要你做什么」; the Chinese channels are three (brief, round report, ruling quotes), and the four-axis analysis is written in English in the analysis section.
- `references/decision-analysis.md` (+12 lines): a decision card opens with a four-line brief (问题 / one sentence per option / the recommendation with one reason / what happens if nobody decides); the four axes, the 四棱 block, the self-check line, confidence gaps and effort precedents stay in the English analysis section. The card's worked example is added without its card number.
- `references/filing-gate.md`, `references/triage-duties.md`, `references/lanes/mobile.md`: wording aligned.
- Scripts: none counts six lines or parses the 「先看」 or 「两分钟验证」 lines. The patrol keys on the heading only (`MAINTAINER_BRIEF_MARKER`), so three comments and two fixture bodies are renamed and nothing else. The TRIAGE sample in `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` now carries a four-line brief and an English options table, and its recall-limit pin is extended to say so.

### 3. Nine passages follow the merged area and grading rules (#35230)

The three review reports the card names are in another project and were not reachable from this run, so this list is my own audit against the rule text that the areas-and-grading rule PR merged (areas, issue types, the grade table, a hand-set grade is final, only the maintainer opens sub-epics). All nine are edited in place; no line is added.

| # | Passage | Old | New |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:180` | `domain:*`、队列与级别只由分诊落笔 | `domain:*` 与队列只由分诊落笔 |
| 2 | `references/execution-duties.md:41` | 认领席自有、优先级继承 | 认领席自有、查表定级 |
| 3 | `references/dispatch-runbook.md:172` | 认领席同笔写父卡域与优先级、附查重词后派发 | 认领席同笔写父卡域、查表定级,附查重词后派发 |
| 4 | `references/seat-post-protocol.md:71` | 例外走 `/pm-dispatch epic:` …;epic PM 不兼 `domain:*` 座位 | 例外由维护者开,走 `/pm-dispatch epic:` …;epic PM 不兼域座位 |
| 5 | `references/seat-post-protocol.md:87` | 明示接受 = 回 p1 + … | 明示接受 = 回查表所得的级 + … |
| 6 | `references/seat-lifecycle.md:64` | 或具名集中例外打 `pm:epic` | 或维护者开 `pm:epic` 集中例外 |
| 7 | `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:42` | 只有三类立卡且不打标签 | 只有三类立卡,标签归代立席 |
| 8 | `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md:160` | 挂 `qa-run`,正常进分诊首触 | 挂 `qa-run`,带 area/type/级,照常进首触 |
| 9 | `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md:182` | 立在修复落地的仓、⛔ 不挂 pm 标签 | 立在修复落地的仓、带 area/type/级,⛔ 不挂 pm 标签 |

Why each contradicted: 1, 2, 3 and 5 said the grade is inherited or written by triage alone, while the merged rule grades every card at filing by the table and keeps a hand-set grade; 4 and 6 let any seat open a `pm:epic` exception, while only the maintainer opens a sub-epic; 7 said a filed card carries no label and 8 and 9 left its labels to triage's first touch, while every public card now carries its area, type and grade at filing.

## Acceptance notes

**Does this PR answer #35246 (stop ranking the blocking label above p1)? Yes, in full.** The label is out of the vocabulary script, the patrol's read order for queued cards is the grade ladder alone (pinned: a p1 card is read before a card carrying only the retired label), and the rule text has no rank that is not a grade. Whether #35246 rides this PR as an extra closing line is the seat's call; this body does not claim it.

**Line budget** (measured lines = ceiling, headroom 0, against `origin/main` at `35c6331094`):

| File | Before | After | Delta | Ruling of record |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `references/state-machine.md` | 43 | 50 | +7 | card body of #35259, items 1 to 4, 7, 9, 10 |
| `references/decision-analysis.md` | 49 | 62 | +13 | +1: comments 6998694957 and 6999656302; +12: card body of #35298 |
| `references/filing-gate.md` | 83 | 87 | +4 | +2: card body of #35259, items 6 and 8; +2: comment 6998230415 |
| `references/execution-duties.md` | 190 | 189 | -1 | lowered: card body of #35259, item 5 |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 405 | 410 | +5 | +2: comment 6998694957 and item 8; +3: card body of #35298 |

Every other touched text file is edited in place, +0: `SKILL.md` 329, `triage-duties.md` 108, `coordinator.md` 51, `dispatch-runbook.md` 246, `seat-lifecycle.md` 100, `seat-post-protocol.md` 88, `lanes/director.md` 82, `lanes/mobile.md` 56, `lanes/objectstack.md` 35, `checklist-test/SKILL.md` 279, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 179. Each raise is an ordinary ruled raise recorded on its row; no line was bought by re-wrapping. Every added or changed prose line is at most 120 bytes; the one changed table row in `checklist-test/SKILL.md` is 214 bytes against that file's 221-byte pin.

**Where this PR departs from the dispatch order, and why:**

- Commits: the order asks for one commit per card. This branch does not allow a force-push, so the history is the checkpoint, three work-in-progress commits and one ratchet commit for the first card, one commit for the second, one for the third, and four merges of `main`. The per-card boundaries are `de68afd197` (end of the first), `7a3967cb52` (second), `566e095791` (third).
- Commit trailers: the repository's rule and its pre-push hook require the model-free pair, so every commit ends with the session line and the model-free co-author line; no model identifier is in any commit, the title or this body outside the one verbatim quotation above.
- The second card's own text says it opens as a separate PR after the first merges; the claim folds the three into one PR on the maintainer's word quoted above.

**Limits of the new patrol rows, by design:**

- H78 does not decide whether a grade was set by hand; the row names the read (the newest `labeled` event) that decides who acts.
- H78, H79 and H80 read this repository's edges. A blocker or a dependent living in a sibling repository is outside these rows, unread rather than absent; the rule text itself covers the cross-repository case.
- H81 counts from the card's creation, or from the earlier ruling when a card re-entered the decision box.
- A card that still carries the retired label keeps it: the close tool no longer strips it and the patrol no longer counts it. Stripping it from cards, or deleting the label object, is a separate act for the seat.
- The copies of this patrol in the sibling repositories still carry H14 and H15 until they are synced.
- The patrol's family-ledger row cap moves from 64 to 72 to hold the five new rows.

**Readings of the second card that the seat may want to confirm:**

- "The Chinese four-channel wording" is read as: the four-axis analysis leaves the Chinese channels and is written in English in the analysis section, for new records only.
- The approve-ask line in `SKILL.md` still names the PASS comment id and the head sha; the card's ⛔ list does not name them, so only the label was renamed.
- The seat's own opinion line after the brief is kept; the card does not rule on it.
- On a surface that is not governed, the last line now says 「无」, as the card writes it.

**Third card: passages read and left, each with why it stays.**

<details>
<summary>Eleven groups of passages that look related and do not contradict the merged rules</summary>

- `SKILL.md:121` (the `finding` row, 待首次定级) and its restatements in `triage-duties.md` and `seat-lifecycle.md`: the label still marks a card awaiting triage's first touch; no action differs.
- `triage-duties.md:57` (a card lacking `reach:` is graded p3): the merged rule PR rewrote the next line and kept this one.
- `execution-duties.md:52` and `:57` (tie-breaks inside the take order): outside the card's five themes; the merged rule PR rewrote the lines around them.
- `lanes/queue.md:17` (an anchor card's grade belongs to triage): an anchor card, which the merged rules treat apart.
- `lanes/skills.md:27`, `lanes/spec.md:25` and `:29` (`Suggested-grade:`): written by the merged rule PR itself.
- `seat-post-protocol.md:80-86` (release-board p0 up and down): the hand-set rule in the filing gate binds every seat, and the label tool refuses mechanically.
- `checklist-test/SKILL.md:146-148` and `scenario-eval/SKILL.md:125` (a record card carries only its record label): the merged first-touch backstop exempts `qa-run`; `eval-run` is not yet in that exclusion list, and `scenario-eval/SKILL.md:147` already says so. If the review's finding C18 is this passage, it needs the maintainer's word; it is not edited here.
- `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` section 6, `lanes/eval.md:19` and `:36`, `lanes/qa.md:28`, `lanes/queue.md:31` (以 `finding` 报): the merged rule PR kept this phrase in `lanes/qa.md:28` while rewriting line 26, so it is not a contradiction; `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` is not touched by this PR.
- `filing-gate.md` (p3 copy and docs nits go to the loose-ends card): consistent with the grade table.
- `area-lease.md` (the regrade list of the area's first step): it lands after the maintainer has looked.
- `decision-analysis.md` (a platform card filed out of an application-repository ruling takes the ruled card's grade): a ruling's own grade, not an inherited one.

Because the review reports were unreachable, which passages the reports call C18 is unconfirmed; rows 8 and 9 above are the `checklist-test` passages this audit found.

</details>

**Overlap check** at head `7c80463a86` against `origin/main` `0967cbe6a2`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`. `origin/main` merges cleanly and no open PR shares a file with this branch. #35373, the sibling card that conflicted in `triage-duties.md` and the patrol script, landed as `0967cbe6a2` and is merged in: H13 reads `area:*` as `main` has it, H14 and H15 stay retired, and `triage-duties.md` keeps this branch's type line beside `main`'s backstop line (108 lines, ceiling 108).

**Not part of this PR, seen on the way:** `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 1 on this branch (`platform-core.seed-mode-matrix: VARIANTS STALE`, the enum reader finds 0 members of `SeedMode` where the item expects 5). The files that finding reads are byte-identical on `main`, so the red is `main`'s and not this diff's; the gate is kept off per-PR CI and its scheduled patrol owns the anchor card.
